name: x-ray
description: Create original radiographic images with coherent transmission, layered density, and visible internal structure.

interface.shortDescription: Radiographic images with layered density and internal structure
interface.longDescription: A transferable visual workflow for X-ray transmission imagery across objects, textiles, people, animals, and actions. Separate subject and gesture from projection, material attenuation, display polarity, and image texture, then inspect realism and structural limits.
defaultPrompt: Create an X-ray image of this subject.
Turn this action into a coherent radiographic scene.
Keep this X-ray reference consistent while changing one detail.
